detail: Recorded the Partner Accreditation & Competency Roadmap as durable project memory: source link, 83-module tracker snapshot, program paths, badge map, competency themes, and planning/writeback rules.
action: Load memory/roadmap.md before roadmap, batch, or module-planning work; verify freshness against the live workbook.

decision: Created scroll-canvas-v1: a reusable single-page scroll design system, documented at plan/06-scroll-canvas-design-system.md, implemented at shared/theme/scroll-canvas.css.
reason: Product request for one scrolling page instead of paged screens, styled from current glean.com. Kept as a separate additive system so the existing paged design system stays valid for the 11 already-built agent modules.
reapply: Set design_system: scroll-canvas-v1, copy the stylesheet, choose 10-14 bands, follow section 11 of the spec.

decision: Defined honest progress for a scroll module: progress equals the deepest band actually reached via IntersectionObserver, and completion requires all bands visited AND quiz mastery.
reason: A scroll page has no pages, so 'reaching the bottom' is not evidence of learning. Verified by test: passing the quiz alone leaves status incomplete.

decision: Built AGT-101 as a new 100-level entry point rather than rebuilding FND-104.
reason: The existing agents path opens at 200 level and assumes platform vocabulary. Owner selected a new module ID after being offered the concrete alternatives.
open_item: AGT-101 is not in the roadmap Module Tracker, and overlaps FND-104/FND-105.

decision: Built OPS-107 (Glean Support Center & Escalations) and OPS-108 (Using Gleaniverse Community) as two new standalone paged-v1 modules, not as a rebuild of OPS-103.
reason: OPS-103 covers the broader partner support operating model (L1/L2 tiers, Support Optimization playbook). Owner selected two new IDs after being offered concrete alternatives.
open_item: Neither module is in the Module Tracker or an accreditation; candidate electives for accred-support-adoption.

decision: Product and support documentation (docs.glean.com, glean.com/sla) is tier 1; internal field FAQs are tier 2; meeting notes and pre-migration decks are excluded from learner-facing claims.
reason: The 2026 Fin/Gleaniverse support migration made earlier support decks obsolete, and meeting notes are not policy.
